_orgwave.title: GitHub
_orgwave.purpose: List/filter org repos and GitHub metadata during OrgWave discovery.
env: Optional: run `cd orgwave/mcp-runtime && npm ci` once for fast MCP startup (avoids slow npx cold install).
~/.cursor/github-mcp.env or ~/.config/orgwave/github-mcp.env (GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=... or GITHUB_TOKEN=...) when Cursor was opened from Dock/GitHub Run-in-Cursor (no shell profile), or
GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN in the Cursor process env (e.g. ~/.zshrc + launch Cursor from that terminal), or
gh logged in (github-mcp-launch.mjs prepends Homebrew to PATH and runs `gh auth token` with stdin detached so MCP stdio is not consumed)
